A '''holovid data spool''' or '''vid-spool''' was a data storage medium used in security recording software. [[Sehn Baroule]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] manager of [[Premier Provisions]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyed Kant]], had a data spool with a montage of scenes from the security system about the events that had transpired on [[sprawl 34]].
